headword: {言語能力|げんごのうりょく}

definitions.gloss: language ability; linguistic competence; proficiency in understanding and using language
definitions.explanation: A person's capacity to understand, produce, and use language — whether their native language or a foreign one. The word is common in educational, psychological, medical (language development or impairment), and linguistic discussions; it also appears in job postings about required foreign-language skills.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{言語|げんご}→言語：02717_gengo⟧ (language) and ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧ (ability, capacity). It is a formal, somewhat academic word — more technical than the everyday expression "⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧" (good at Japanese). It covers four classical skill areas — listening, speaking, reading, and writing — and is often used to discuss testing, child development, and brain function.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {言語能力|げんごのうりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: to have high language ability
- {言語能力|げんごのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧: to build up one's language ability
- {言語能力|げんごのうりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve language ability
- ⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{言語能力|げんごのうりょく}: English language ability
- {言語能力|げんごのうりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発達|はったつ}→発達：03559_hattatsu⟧: the development of language ability

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{語学力|ごがくりょく}→語学力：29443_gogakuryoku⟧: foreign language ability — typically refers to learned foreign languages, not one's native language
- ⟦{国語力|こくごりょく}→国語力：28017_kokugoryoku⟧: Japanese language ability — used especially in education about a child's command of Japanese
- ⟦コミュニケーション{能力|のうりょく}→コミュニケーション能力：25825_komyunikeeshonnouryoku⟧: communication ability — broader, covers nonverbal skills too
- {言語運用|げんごうんよう}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: linguistic performance — a more technical term from linguistics, close to Chomsky's "performance"
